description: Hi for everyone! I'm digital comic artist,I'm looking for someone with a good knowledge of space, NASA-related technology, and the history of NASA missions and equipment.
summary: My book(or journal ...)is about the history of space exploration and the robots that helped us discover Mars and the Moon. I wanted to introduce readers to different generations of robotic explorers, from the early Mariner and Viking missions to Sojourner, Spirit and Opportunity. I explain how these machines worked, what they looked like, and what they discovered. Through this book, I hope to make space science easier and more interesting for young readers. I want to show that even small robots can make huge contributions to our understanding of other worlds.
details: Forgotten Space Explorers is an illustrated educational digital book about early robotic missions that helped humanity explore the Moon and Mars. The project introduces young readers to historic spacecraft and rovers, including Mariner 4, Mariner 9, Surveyor 1, Viking 1 and 2, Spirit and Opportunity. Each page focuses on one mission and includes its launch date, history, main objectives, achievements, photographs, and interesting facts. The information is presented in short, accessible sections to make space exploration easier to understand for younger audiences.The project makes space history more accessible and engaging for children and beginners. It helps readers discover important but sometimes overlooked missions and understand how early robotic explorers contributed to our knowledge of other worlds. Its goal is to encourage curiosity about astronomy, science, and future space exploration.The project was developed as a digital illustrated book using digital document and graphic design tools. NASA's publicly available educational resources, mission information, and historical photographs were used as research materials.
